recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of two men and two young children fishing by a pond, set against a dense wooded background, featuring heavy, stylized western-inspired typography at the top and clean serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The central subjects are positioned in the lower third, creating a grounded, intimate feel.
The verticality of the trees in the background contrasts with the horizontal lines of the fishing rods.
The heavy, ornate top logo balances the dark water at the bottom of the frame.
The grayscale tonal range emphasizes texture in the grass, water, and foliage.
coreInvariants: Outdoor setting with a body of water in the foreground.
Candid, non-posed interaction between the subjects.
Heavy, decorative display type for the primary brand name.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are seated in the lower center, occupying approximately 20% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized logo at the top center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top logo, moves down the vertical trees to the seated figures, follows the fishing rods outward, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the dense, out-of-focus forest background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the forest background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and water reflections.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright whites in the typography outlines and highlights on the water.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white text and dark background elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with western and psychedelic influences.
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with internal decorative cutouts.
Double-outline effect creating a 3D or sticker-like appearance.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' and 'M' are nestled into the curves of the 'G' and 'B'.
The 'L' and 'U' feature sharp, angular serifs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, heavy display type paired with a clean, widely-spaced traditional serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Sticker-style white border around the main logo.
Horizontal rule-like spacing for the bottom text.

preserve: The double-outline effect on the top text
The wide tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy western slab-serif aesthetic.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman Bold or Century Schoolbook
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic serif look for the bottom subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white photograph of two men in their 30s and 60s sitting in camping chairs by a calm pond, each holding a young child. They are holding fishing rods extending over the water. The background is a dense, slightly blurred forest of deciduous trees. The lighting is overcast and soft.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line stacked logo in the top center using a heavy, decorative western-style font with a thick white outline. Add a single line of small, widely-spaced serif text in all-caps at the bottom center, positioned over the dark water.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Does the top logo have a distinct white 'sticker' border?
Is the bottom text widely spaced and easy to read?
Are the fishing rods visible and creating leading lines?

adjustableVariables: Amount of grain in the film effect
Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces that resemble real public figures
Specific brand logos on the clothing or chairs

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between top and bottom text
Clear separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the water reflection looks natural in grayscale.
Check that the text outline doesn't obscure the letterforms.
Verify the subjects are in focus while the background is softly blurred.
Confirm the aspect ratio is square for an album cover format.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a candid outdoor family moment in B&W + Add heavy western-style display type at the top + Add clean, wide-spaced serif type at the bottom.
